content.title: Trump ally Jim Jordan wins House minority leader election
content.caption: Jim Jordan, a Republican hardliner from Ohio, wins the election to become the next House minority leader in Congress.

slides.heading: Jim Jordan Wins House Minority Leader Election
slides.text: Republican Jim Jordan wins the election to become the next House minority leader in Congress.

slides.heading: Who is Jim Jordan?
slides.text: Jim Jordan is a Republican hardliner from Ohio.
slides.image_search_query: Jim Jordan, Ohio, Republican United States

slides.heading: How did he win?
slides.text: Jordan beat Representative Steve Scalise, the current majority leader, by 106-73 in a closed-door vote.

slides.heading: Why is this important?
slides.text: This win is crucial for the Republican party to advance their legislative aims and fend off aggressive oversight that Democrats have promised in the next Congress.
